mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0020.retrievePayrollSummary */ t.category AS CATEGORY ,t.head_count AS num_of_people ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.salary_bef_tax + t.pit_adjustment + t.trade_union_amount + t.insurance_amount - t.ot_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS salary ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.ot_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS ot ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.insurance_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS insurance ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.trade_union_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS trade_union ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.salary_bef_tax + t.pit_adjustment, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS salary_bef_tax ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.tax_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS pit_full ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.pit_adjustment, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS pit_adjustment_full ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(t.net_pay_amount, '999,999,999,999,999')) AS net_pay FROM ( SELECT GROUPING_ID(ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id, r.employment_category_code) grouping_id ,CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id, r.employment_category_code) = 0 THEN r.employment_category_code ELSE 'TOTAL' END AS CATEGORY ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(COUNT(*), '999,999,999,999,999')) head_count ,SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(cr.result_value) FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n cr ,tb_pay_payroll_item_m pi WHERE cr.payroll_item_id = pi.payroll_item_id AND cr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = r.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND cr.employee_no = r.employee_no AND pi.payroll_item_calc_prrt_value = '300'), 0)) ot_amount ,SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(cr.result_value) FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n cr ,tb_pay_payroll_item_m pi WHERE cr.payroll_item_id = pi.payroll_item_id AND cr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = r.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND cr.employee_no = r.employee_no AND pi.payroll_item_calc_prrt_value = '2100'), 0)) insurance_amount ,SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(cr.result_value) FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n cr ,tb_pay_payroll_item_m pi WHERE cr.payroll_item_id = pi.payroll_item_id AND cr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = r.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND cr.employee_no = r.employee_no AND pi.payroll_item_calc_prrt_value = CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ce.basis_date) >= 2019 THEN '2300' ELSE '2400' END), 0)) trade_union_amount ,SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(cr.result_value) FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n cr ,tb_pay_payroll_item_m pi WHERE cr.payroll_item_id = pi.payroll_item_id AND cr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = r.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND cr.employee_no = r.employee_no AND pi.payroll_item_calc_prrt_value = '99998'), 0)) pit_adjustment ,SUM(NVL(r.tax_amount, 0))+SUM(NVL(r.bank_transfer_amount, 0)) salary_bef_tax ,SUM(NVL(r.tax_amount, 0)) tax_amount ,SUM(NVL(r.bank_transfer_amount, 0)) net_pay_amount FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n ce ,tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n cee ,tb_pay_result_s r WHERE ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id = cee.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id = r.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND cee.employee_no = r.employee_no AND ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{calculationExecId} -- 조회조건 --AND ce.confirm_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY ROLLUP( ce.payroll_calculation_exec_id ,r.employment_category_code ) ) t WHERE 1 = 1 AND t.grouping_id IN ('0', '3') ORDER BY DECODE(t.category, 'LGD_LW', 2, 'LGD_OW', '1', '0')

SELECT /* LGVPAYP0020.retrieveCalcExecId */ payroll_calculation_exec_id AS calculation_exec_id ,payroll_type_code AS payroll_type_code ,payroll_calculation_set_id AS calculation_set_id FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n WHERE 1 = 1 AND request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND request_code = #{requestCode}
